pages.text: This item stores a route for the tug. When the item is placed in the tug’s route slot, the tug will follow the route in order from node 0.

Point at navigable water and right click to create an in-progress tug route. Hover node 0 to preview the route in green, then right click it to complete the loop. On a completed route, hover and right click a yellow segment to insert a waypoint. Right click existing nodes to remove them.
